title: Isolation of Signet Ring Cells from Human Gastric Mucosa
author: Samaranayake, Gamble, et al.
materials: VWR standard line sterile centrifuge tubes

steps.title: Isolate gastric mucosa
steps.instruction: Remove the total gastrectomy specimen, place it on a clean back table, cut away perigastric soft tissue with scissors, incise the stomach along the greater curvature, expose the entire gastric mucosa and pin it mucosal‑side up to a cork or wax board, identify a region of ~5 cm², gently incise the mucosa with a #15 scalpel, lift the tissue with Gerald forceps, extend the incision at the mucosal‑submucosal interface, brush the submucosa down with the scalpel bevel up while lifting the mucosa, and keep submucosal vessels with the submucosa.

steps.title: Weigh and collect mucosa
steps.instruction: Immediately weigh the isolated mucosa in a dry petri dish on a digital pocket scale, continue dissecting until at least 1 g of tissue (≈1–2 cm diameter piece) is obtained, record the mass, and transfer the mucosa to MACS Tissue Storage Solution on ice.

steps.title: Fix cells for embedding
steps.instruction: Place the dissociated gastric cells in a 15 mL conical tube and fix them in either 70 % ethanol or 10 % neutral‑buffered formalin for 24–48 h.

steps.title: Pellet cells and add HistoGel
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the fixed cells at 1000 × g for 5 min, carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the pellet, add 1 mL pre‑heated, liquefied HistoGel, tap the tube to dislodge the pellet and ensure the gel fully surrounds it, then place the tube on ice for ~2 min to solidify.

steps.title: Solidify and trim HistoGel core
steps.instruction: Using a laboratory spatula, gently pry the solidified HistoGel core containing the cells from the tube, place the core on a cutting board, bisect it longitudinally with a razor blade into two equal halves, trim away excess gel (the top portion without cells), and place both trimmed halves cut‑side down into a pre‑labeled Tissue‑Tek Processing/Embedding Cassette, applying gentle pressure.

substeps.instruction: Pause point: the HistoGel‑embedded cells may be stored indefinitely at 4 °C before trimming.

steps.title: Process embedded tissue
steps.instruction: Load the cassette into the Tissue‑Tek VIP 6 AI Vacuum Filtration Processor and run the following processing schedule: 70 % ethanol 30 min at RT; 80 % ethanol 30 min at RT; 95 % ethanol 30 min at RT; 100 % ethanol 30 min at RT; 100 % xylene 30 min at RT; paraffin 45 min at 60 °C; paraffin 30 min at 60 °C.

steps.title: Perform PAS staining
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize and hydrate slides to water, immerse in 1 % Periodic Acid Solution for 8 min then rinse several times with distilled water, incubate in Schiff’s Leuco‑Fuchsin Solution for 10 min and wash in running tap water for 5 min, counterstain with Mayer’s hematoxylin for 15 s and wash, dip in 1 % Lithium Carbonate (or equivalent bluing reagent) for 1–2 s and wash for 5 min, then dehydrate and clear in xylene.

substeps.instruction: Pause point: the double‑staining procedure can be paused indefinitely after the xylene step.

steps.title: Perform E‑cadherin staining
steps.instruction: Retrieve antigens by heating slides in 1× Antigen Unmasking Solution (Vector Labs Cat# H‑3300‑250) for 10 min at 100 °C, dilute the E‑Cadherin primary antibody 1:400 (Cell Signaling Cat# 3195, RRID: AB_2291471), incubate slides in the primary antibody for ~16 h at 4 °C, dilute Biotinylated Goat anti‑Rabbit (Vector Labs SKU BA‑1000‑1.5, RRID: AB_2313606) 1:100 for secondary staining, then mount with Permount and a coverslip.
